fields.description: The one file this link hands over. A folder is not offered: a link to a folder is a link to everything somebody puts in it afterwards.
fields.label: File

fields.description: What it was made for, in the words of whoever made it.
fields.label: Label

fields.description: What is in the URL. Long enough not to be guessed, and the only thing standing between the link and the file.
fields.label: Secret

fields.description: After this the link is gone and the file is not. Empty is refused on purpose: a link with no end is a file published for ever by somebody who has left.
fields.label: Expires On

fields.description: Taken back early. Kept rather than deleted, so 'who shared this and when did it stop' has an answer.
fields.label: Revoked

fields.description: How many times it was followed.
fields.label: Opened
